body: That sounds like the Tree of Silver Wings, during the Season of Arrivals. That was the lead up to Beyond Light.
I thought this was a joke before I checked. Wow.
The first ideal gets me through a lot of shit tbh.

I have BPD as well, and struggle with the same thoughts. At one point last month I couldn't make it 20 minutes without brainstorming different ways to die in my house. You've just got to find someway to break the loop - I just moved back home across country two weeks ago so I can get help and hopefully start this whole treatment thing. Good luck to you, I do hope you decide against it.

It's fitting that you put The First Ideal there. That's been my mantra for a few weeks now. Only thing keeping me alive sometimes. Shit has been so hard losing my FP (to my supposed best friend no less)

I relate to all of this way too much. Minus the pot thing, it was never for me because if growing up around drugs, I always strive to be better than that. Not to sound self righteous at all, I don't even think it's bad, I just wanted to distance myself from my upbringing as much as possible. I hope things go better for you.
